stem: What result follows this event in the passage: “The school could not replace it immediately”?
options: No one used it for soup anymore
The class tried to solve the problem
He sat quietly while others bought food

本文可直接核對「the class tried to solve the problem」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「He tried it」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「He sat quietly while others bought food」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
